_note: Lunar reference per base type. The 0-1 values in scores.csv ARE the similarity to the Moon (1 = equal to the Moon); there are no 0-1 target values. Moon values are raw, in earth_unit. score_method: target = similarity, counts in SCORE_TOTAL if weight > 0; display = similarity shown but weight 0; rank = no lunar value yet, rank within one run, NOT in scores.csv; not computed = no pipeline value yet.
